name: Baweja Studios Ltd.
summary: Baweja Studios Ltd. operates in the media and entertainment industry, primarily focusing on the production and distribution of motion pictures, web series, television shows, and other digital content. The company's core offerings include Hindi and Punjabi films, animation content, advertisement films, and music videos. It engages in end-to-end content production, from script research and development to post-production and marketing. Baweja Studios also focuses on intellectual property creation and monetization, including trading movie rights. Its target markets include India and international audiences, with content distributed across theatrical releases, digital platforms, and global streaming services. The company emphasizes high-quality storytelling and integrates advanced technologies like visual effects and animation in its productions.
